M: Individual pieces of business functionality that are independently developed, deployed, and managed.
A: All functionality is exposed through an API.
C: SaaS that leverages the cloud, beyond storage and hosting, including elastic scaling and automatically updating. 
H: Frontend presentation is decoupled from back-end logic and channel, programming language, and is framework agnostic.

1. Fast loading times
We are on the mission to improve loading times for eCommerce users, especially on mobile. We want every eCommerce site to load under 2 seconds for all users across the globe.

2. Fast Time To Market
Vue Storefront is a headless API Hub, giving merchants the ability to connect with any eCommerce backend, any CMS or any other 3rd party service, as we provide those APIâ€™s by default in our cloud platform. Also, because of the Progressive Web App features that we provide, there is no need to build native iOS or Android apps - everything is available through the web. In combination with frontend components provided out of the box, it is possible to build a new eCommerce frontend within weeks, not months. 

3. Fast content adjustments 
Our Visual Builder is a killer feature that gives Marketing & Business the ability to make instant updates on the frontend without help from Developers (no-code).
